newsitem.title: USA: Brylane Inc Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Brylane Inc Q1 net rises.

text.p: Net income figure is pro forma. Pro forma operating income increased 19.0% to $26.3 million versus $22.1 million for the first quarter of last year. Pro forma net sales for the period grew 16.3% to $328.8 million compared to $282.7 million in the first quarter last year. Pro forma comparisons include Brylane's acquisition of Chadwick's on December 9, 1996; the completion of its Initial Public Offering of 4,000,000 shares in February 1997, as if the transactions had been completed on the first day of each of the respective fiscal periods; and corporate income taxes at a 37% effective rate. The comparisons exclude certain nonrecurring charges related to the Chadwick's acquisition, the modification of certain options in the fourth quarter of 1996, and certain extraordinary charges related to the elimination in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 of deferred financing fees associated with Brylane's Bank Credit Facility.
